novelty_flags.one_line: The core attributes generic Young-inequality contrast-envelope assembly to Theorem 4.5, but the cited camera-ready makes Theorem 4.5 only the buyer-spillover example; generic linear contrasts are handled by the displayed formula after Theorem 4.4 and Lemma A.18.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:finite-game-approximation-certificate and oeq:sharp-observed-data-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: No rank-K truncated schedule, experiment, likelihood, or calibrated-risk functional is defined: K only labels stored singular enclosures while the displayed game retains full completion cells, so the asserted spectral-tail risk change and its 3/(2√(K+1)) bound have no defined left-hand object.

Correct every Masoero citation: cite Theorem 4.4 plus the generic Young-inequality display or Lemma A.18 for the direct-effect envelope, and reserve Theorem 4.5 for buyer spillover.

Retag the absolute variance floor as a proposal-specific condition or provide the exact published finite-population nondegeneracy condition it is meant to instantiate; Li–Ding’s standard CLT condition is scale-invariant and is not obviously this floor.
